newsitem.title: CHINA: China imports seen growing 8-12 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China imports seen growing 8-12 pct in 1997.

text.p: China's imports are expected to grow by 8-12 percent to reach between $150 billion and $155 billion in 1997, Xinhua news agency said on Sunday, quoting Qiu Xichun, a senior trade expert.
China's exports are expected to reach between $155 billion and $166 billion in 1997, up by 3.0-6.0 percent compared with 1996, he said.
"Dynamic export growth is not likely in following years," he added, but gave no further details. China's exports edged up 1.5 percent in 1996.
China registered a trade surplus of $12.24 billion in 1996 on exports of $151.07 and imports of $138.83. The trade surplus in 1995 was $16.7 billion.
China's Foreign Trade Minister Wu Yi has said China's foreign trade volume was expected to reach $310 billion in 1997.
